thread:
One editor. Six Indian dialects. An AI-animated Hanuman series for STAGE.

Here's what making it actually looks like 🧵

The dialects: Haryanvi, Bhojpuri, Rajasthani, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali.

Same story, six voices. People who grew up speaking a dialect catch a bad dub in the first line.

Hardest problem isn't generation. It's consistency.

What works: one locked 3D style, asset tags for every character and prop, and a master list of camera angles, all frozen before shot one.

Second hardest: dialogue. Every line is rewritten per dialect and voiced in ElevenLabs v3 with emotion tags.

A Haryanvi taunt is not a translated Bengali taunt.

If you're an editor moving into AI: your cut sense is the moat. Models give you shots. You still decide which 3 seconds matter.

Breaking down each step here over the next few weeks.
